passive.name: Junkyard Titan
passive.description: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.
passive.coverageNote: The full patch description is retained and assigned to the timed-stat-modifier family, but a complete reviewed binding has not been compiled yet.

spells.name: Flamespitter
spells.description: Rumble ignites his flamethrower, dealing plus % max Health magic damage over seconds, reduced to % against minions. Danger Zone: Damage is increased to plus max Health. Percent damage is limited to damage on Monsters.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation FlatDamage was preserved. Stateful and alternate effects require an explicit module.

spells.name: Electro Harpoon
spells.description: Rumble launches an electrified harpoon, dealing magic damage, Slowing by % for seconds, and reducing the enemy's Magic Resist by % for seconds. Hitting an enemy who's already Slowed by this Ability increases the Slow to % and reduces the enemy's Magic Resist by % Danger Zone: The harpoon deals magic damage instead and the Slow and reduced Magic Resist are increased by 50%.
